description: This file contains implementation of RNN, LSTM, and GRU modules in PyTorch, including class definitions, forward methods, and utility functions for recurrent neural networks.

classes.name: RNNImpl
classes.description: Implementation of a basic RNN module with options for different nonlinearities.

classes.name: LSTMImpl
classes.description: Implementation of an LSTM module with support for multiple layers and bidirectionality.

classes.name: GRUImpl
classes.description: Implementation of a GRU module with support for multiple layers and bidirectionality.

classes.name: RNNCellImpl
classes.description: Base implementation for RNN cell with configurable nonlinearity.

methods.name: forward_helper
methods.description: Helper function to process input through RNN, LSTM, or GRU layers.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Performs forward pass for RNN, LSTM, or GRU modules.

methods.name: forward_with_packed_input
methods.description: Forward pass for packed sequence input.

methods.name: permute_hidden
methods.description: Permutes hidden states according to provided permutation.

methods.name: check_forward_args
methods.description: Checks validity of input and hidden states.

methods.name: get_expected_hidden_size
methods.description: Calculates expected hidden state size based on input.

methods.name: flatten_parameters
methods.description: Flattens weights for optimized cuDNN operations.

methods.name: to
methods.description: Moves module to specified device and dtype.

methods.name: check_input
